protocol.selection: Every eighth saved moving known-goal state within each of 16 episodes, excluding final input. No neural result used.
protocol.state_timing: Saved post-update h_t/c_t; intervene on actual next input at t+1.
protocol.metrics: Expected noiseless one-step progress towards the true goal disk in mm, and target translation projected towards true center. Equal episode weight per seed.
protocol.statistics: Exploratory. Eight training seeds. Four comparisons Holm within each metric/subset; not corrected across metrics/subsets.
limitations: Scripted physical experience; policy does not select actions.
One-step progress undercounts turn actions whose benefit is delayed.
Same-state goal changes are causal instantaneous input effects, not new closed-loop navigation scores.
Different native policies have their own recurrent states/weights; native comparison is descriptive.
